items.statement: A consistent computational protocol and common Int3 reference are stated.
items.expected: Protocol, solvent, temperature/standard state, and common reference are explicit.

items.statement: Each TS is validated by frequency and endpoint connection.
items.expected: One imaginary frequency and IRC or justified endpoint test are reported.

items.statement: Meta, para, and ortho candidates are identified and covered.
items.expected: Each channel has candidate identity, reacting atoms, and coverage.

items.statement: Relative barriers are 11.6, 12.2, and 18.2 kcal/mol for meta, para, and ortho.
items.expected: Submitted barriers reproduce the source values.

items.statement: The ordering is meta < para < ortho.
The meta Int3-to-Int4 step is exergonic by about 2.8 kcal/mol.
items.expected: If reported, the change is approximately -2.8 kcal/mol.
